format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

# Leemos el dataset y aplicamos un filtro simple para asegurar rangos reales
dataset <- read_csv("dataset.csv") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(harddisk = ifelse(!is.na(harddisk) & harddisk <= 8, harddisk * 1000, harddisk)) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(screen_size) | (screen_size >= 10 & screen_size <= 21),
    is.na(harddisk)    | (harddisk >= 16 & harddisk <= 8000),
    is.na(ram)         | (ram >= 2 & ram <= 128),
    is.na(cpu_speed)   | (cpu_speed >= 0.8 & cpu_speed <= 6),
    is.na(rating)      | (rating >= 1 & rating <= 5),
    !is.na(price)      & (price >= 100 & price <= 12000)
  )
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Distribución del Precio (USD)"
p <- ggplot(dataset, aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Precio (USD)", y = "Frecuencia") +

ggplotly(p)
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Cantidad por Tipo de Gráfica (0 = Integrada, 1 = Dedicada)"
ggplot(dataset, aes(x = factor(graphics), fill = factor(graphics))) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Gráfica (0 = Integrada, 1 = Dedicada)", y = "Cantidad") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}

  theme_minimal() +

```

# Gráficos por Variable

## Row

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Histogramas por Variable"
dataset_long <- dataset %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Valor")

ggplot(dataset_long, aes(x = Valor)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Valor", y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Boxplots por Variable"
ggplot(dataset_long, aes(y = Valor)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = "Valor") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Medidas y Frecuencias

## Row

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Medidas de Posición"
calcular_moda <- function(x) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

medidas_centrales <- sapply(dataset, function(x) {
  c(Media = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Mediana = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Moda = calcular_moda(x))
})
kable(t(medidas_centrales), digits = 2, caption = "Tendencia Central: Media, Mediana y Moda")

cuartiles <- sapply(dataset, function(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE))
kable(t(cuartiles), digits = 2, caption = "Cuartiles")
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Tabla de Frecuencias Agrupadas - Precio (USD)"
num_intervalos <- nclass.Sturges(na.omit(dataset$price))
intervalos <- cut(dataset$price, breaks = num_intervalos, right = FALSE)

tabla_frecuencias <- dataset %>%
  mutate(Clase = intervalos) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Clase)) %>%
  group_by(Clase) %>%
  summarise(Frecuencia_Absoluta = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    Frecuencia_Relativa = Frecuencia_Absoluta / sum(Frecuencia_Absoluta),
    Frecuencia_Porcentual = Frecuencia_Relativa * 100,
    Frecuencia_Acumulada = cumsum(Frecuencia_Absoluta)
  )

kable(tabla_frecuencias, digits = 2)
```
